While resolving Conjecture 13 would provide tangible progress towards Conjecture 1, it is still unclear whether this, in combination with a hypothetical analog of the Flipper game for monadically dependent classes, would be sufficient for obtaining a model checking algorithm, similar to the results in [24] and [14]. Our result about almost linear neighborhood complexity in monadically stable classes, Theorem 4, still leaves room for improvement. Namely, it is known [31] that in (structurally) nowhere dense classes, the result can be generalized to the setting of ϕ-types over a set of parameters A, where ϕ(x̄, ȳ) is any first order formula operating over pairs of tuples of vertices, rather than just on pairs of vertices. Our proof of Theorem 4 does not generalize to this setting, hence the following conjecture remains open. Conjecture 14.
